scene.ko: 대금이 두 번 결제됐다는 고객의 전화에, 원인과 환불 · 재발 방지 방법을 차분히 설명한다.

lines.en: Hi, this is Laura Bennett from Norvell Foods. We just noticed that we were charged twice for last month's order.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 노벨 푸드의 로라 베넷입니다. 지난달 주문 대금이 두 번 결제된 걸 방금 알게 됐어요.

lines.en: I'm very sorry about that, Laura. We found the problem this morning, and I was actually about to call you.
lines.ko: 정말 죄송합니다, 로라 씨. 저희도 오늘 아침에 문제를 발견해서, 마침 전화드리려던 참이었어요.
alt: I'm so sorry, Laura. We found the problem this morning, and I was just going to call you.

lines.en: So what happened? This has never happened before.
lines.ko: 그래서 어떻게 된 거예요? 이런 일은 처음인데요.

lines.en: We updated our billing system over the weekend, and a bug caused some payments to be processed twice. About twenty clients were affected.
lines.ko: 주말에 결제 시스템을 업데이트했는데, 오류 때문에 일부 결제가 두 번 처리됐습니다. 고객사 스무 곳 정도가 영향을 받았어요.
alt: Our billing system was updated last weekend, and an error charged some clients twice. Around twenty clients had the same problem.

lines.en: I see. When will we get the money back? It's a fairly large amount.
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 돈은 언제 돌려받을 수 있나요? 금액이 꽤 커서요.

lines.en: We've already started the refund, so it should arrive within three to five business days. I'll email you a confirmation today.
lines.ko: 이미 환불 절차를 시작해서, 영업일 기준 3~5일 안에 들어갈 거예요. 확인 메일은 오늘 보내 드릴게요.
alt: The refund is already in progress. You should get it within three to five business days, and I'll send you a confirmation email today.

lines.en: Three to five days is a bit long. We have some big payments to make this week.
lines.ko: 3~5일은 좀 기네요. 이번 주에 나갈 큰돈이 있어서요.

lines.en: I understand. Let me see if our finance team can speed it up. Would it help if I called you back within an hour with an answer?
lines.ko: 이해합니다. 재무팀이 더 빨리 처리할 수 있는지 알아볼게요. 한 시간 안에 다시 전화로 답을 드리면 괜찮을까요?
alt: I understand. I'll ask our finance team to process it faster and call you back within an hour. Would that help?

lines.en: Yes, thank you. And how can we be sure this won't happen again?
lines.ko: 네, 고마워요. 그리고 이런 일이 다시 안 생긴다는 건 어떻게 믿을 수 있죠?

lines.en: That's a fair question. We've fixed the bug, and from now on, every payment will be checked by a person before it's processed.
lines.ko: 당연히 물어보실 만해요. 오류는 이미 고쳤고, 앞으로는 모든 결제를 처리하기 전에 사람이 한 번 더 확인할 겁니다.
alt: Good question. The bug has been fixed, and from now on someone will review every payment before it goes through.

expressions.en: It should arrive within ___ business days.
